## Summary

What does this PR do, and why?

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat` — new functionality
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `chore` — tooling/maintenance
- [ ] `test` — test-only change

## Classification

Required / Recommended / Optional / Future Enhancement (per [docs/decision-framework/IMPROVEMENT_CLASSIFICATION.md](../docs/decision-framework/IMPROVEMENT_CLASSIFICATION.md)).

## Related

Closes #{issue}. Links to ADR, if any: `docs/adr/{file}.md`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Follows [docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] Tests added/updated per [docs/TESTING_STANDARDS.md](../docs/TESTING_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer data included
- [ ] No broken links or leftover placeholder text

## How to Test

Steps a reviewer can follow to verify this works.
